data.narrative:
General Biological is a Series A biotech company founded by Abhi Godavarthi and David Sozanski that has raised $6.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public companies in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given available data. Stage-progression analysis uses the $6.6M raised as a proxy for current valuation and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding an implied value of $13.2M. The peer-median approach could not be executed due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the biotech sector meeting minimum sample thresholds (only 1 adjacent peer identified). Public-comp anchoring was inapplicable because General Biological's revenue is undisclosed, preventing meaningful application of the 8.1x median price-to-sales multiple observed across public biotech names.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $15M, with a median estimate of $13M. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue-based metrics, limited peer data at this stage and valuation tier, and reliance on a single methodological input. Stage-progression results should be stress-tested against actual market conditions and comparable company financials as additional data becomes available.
